phase.description: Buckets have a phase, which represents the approximate part of the recruitment process this bucket is for - for example the phase 'interview' might have several buckets (e.g. 'line manager interview', etc.).

description:
Subject: Update to Recruitment Buckets – New Interview Stage

Dear Team,

Please note that we have added a new bucket to our interview phase with the identifier **101**. This bucket is titled **“Line Manager Interview”** and is intended to capture all candidate assessments conducted by the hiring manager. For reference in our configuration files, please use the key **lm_interview** when mapping or querying this stage. Let’s ensure that all relevant candidates are routed to this bucket moving forward.
